description: A firm whose recommendations section was withheld (gated RPC unavailable) — the narrative must say so, not invent recommendations.

at_risk.definition: customers with 2+ lifetime visits whose last visit is 45-180 days before period end

good:
## Summary
Unavail Co grew steadily. Revenue was SGD 2,000.00 this month across the Novena branch.

## What went well
- 4 of 6 identified customers this month had already bought before, a returning-customer share of 66.7%.
- Cruz D. carried 15.0% of all revenue, SGD 300.00.

## What needs attention
- About 90% of revenue came from identified customers; the customer figures describe them.
- 2 regulars have not been seen in a while. One returned visit each is worth SGD 40.00.
- The recommendations section was not available for this report.

## Your customers
2 regulars are at risk; recovering them is worth SGD 40.00 each.

## Do these three things next
1. Send one win-back message to the 2 at-risk regulars this week. SGD 40.00 / 2 customers = SGD 20.00 each.
2. Confirm branch details for the Novena outlet next review.
3. Check back on this report once recommendations become available again.
